mapper.sql: id, question_no, content, type, difficulty, score, teacher_id, subject, answer, analysis, options, language, code_template, test_cases, time_limit, memory_limit, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO question (question_no, content, type, difficulty, score, teacher_id, subject, answer, analysis, options, language, code_template, test_cases, time_limit, memory_limit) VALUES (#{questionNo}, #{content}, #{type}, #{difficulty}, #{score}, #{teacherId}, #{subject}, #{answer}, #{analysis}, #{options}, #{language}, #{codeTemplate}, #{testCases}, #{timeLimit}, #{memoryLimit})
mapper.select: SELECT CASE type WHEN 1 THEN '单选题' WHEN 2 THEN '多选题' WHEN 3 THEN '判断题' WHEN 4 THEN '填空题' WHEN 5 THEN '简答题' WHEN 6 THEN '编程题' ELSE '其他' END as name, COUNT(*) as count FROM question WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY type ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') as month, COUNT(*) as count FROM exam WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC
